name: GitHub
summary: GitHub OAuth Apps are one of the fastest BYO paths. Create an OAuth App in developer settings, set Composio’s redirect URI, copy client ID/secret into a custom auth config. No marketplace review is required for normal OAuth Apps.
whenYouNeedThis: You want your brand on the GitHub consent screen instead of Composio
You need scopes beyond Composio’s managed defaults
You want a dedicated rate-limit quota separate from the shared managed app
prerequisites: Permission to create an OAuth App (personal or organization)
Composio project access to create a custom auth config

steps.title: Decide managed vs custom
steps.detail: Composio provides a managed GitHub OAuth app. Use managed for prototypes. Switch to custom when branding, scopes, or quota matter.

steps.title: Create a GitHub OAuth App
steps.detail: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App. Set Homepage URL to your product URL.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and generate Client Secret
steps.detail: Generate a new client secret once and store it securely. You will paste both into Composio.

steps.title: Create Composio custom auth config
steps.detail: Dashboard → Create Auth Config → GitHub → OAuth2 → use your own credentials. Paste Client ID/Secret and confirm redirect URI.

steps.title: Wire auth config into your agent session
steps.detail: Pass the auth config ID when creating a session / initiating a connection so users authorize your app, not Composio’s.

blockers: Wrong callback URL (typos or trailing slash mismatches) breaks the redirect
Organization policies may restrict who can create OAuth Apps
Requesting sensitive org scopes may require org admin approval on install — not GitHub App review, but still a human gate
nuances: GitHub OAuth Apps ≠ GitHub Apps. This guide covers OAuth Apps used for user authorization.
No public marketplace approval is required to use an OAuth App with your own users.
User-to-server rate limits apply per OAuth App — your own app gets its own quota.
agentCanDo: Confirm whether Composio managed auth is available for GITHUB
Draft the exact redirect URI and checklist
Locate official GitHub OAuth App docs and required fields
Explain scope tradeoffs for common agent use cases
humanMustDo: Log into GitHub and create the OAuth App
Generate and copy the client secret
Paste credentials into Composio (never share secrets with an agent chat)
Approve org-level access if an organization requires it
nextAction: If you only need to prototype: use Composio managed GitHub auth now. If production branding matters: create the GitHub OAuth App and set the Composio callback URL today — there is no approval queue.

notes: Managed OAuth is available for GITHUB; custom auth is optional.
After creating the auth config, pass its ID when initiating connections.
